scripts.name: Setup Worktree
scripts.command: ROOT="${T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT:-${T3_PROJECT_ROOT:-$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)")}}" && ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd -P)" && if [ "$ROOT" != "$(pwd -P)" ]; then if [ -f "$ROOT/.env" ]; then cp -p "$ROOT/.env" .env; fi && if [ -d "$ROOT/memory" ]; then mkdir -p memory && cp -Rp "$ROOT/memory/." memory/; fi; fi
